intro: Looking for your next escape? Spiti Valley delivers: a cold desert of monasteries and moonscapes. Here is everything you need to plan a trip.

sections.heading: Why visit Spiti Valley
paragraphs: Spiti Valley (Himachal Pradesh) is known for its mountain, adventure and roadtrip experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is June to September.

sections.heading: How to get there
paragraphs: Drive via Shimla–Kinnaur (open most of the year) or via Manali when the passes are open.

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Fuel stations are rare — fill up at Kaza and carry cash.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Spiti Valley?
How do I reach Spiti Valley?
faq.a: Drive via Shimla–Kinnaur (open most of the year) or via Manali when the passes are open.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Spiti Valley?
faq.a: Popular choices: Kaza as the base; Homestays in Langza and Komic.
